mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.knowledge_id AS knowledgeId, k.knowledge_name AS knowledgeName, c.doc_id AS docId, d.doc_title AS docTitle, c.chunk_no AS chunkNo, c.chunk_content AS chunkContent, c.chunk_token_count AS chunkTokenCount, c.vector_id AS vectorId, c.embed_status AS embedStatus, c.recall_count AS recallCount, c.status, c.create_time AS createTime FROM bedrock_ai_knowledge_chunk c LEFT JOIN bedrock_ai_knowledge k ON c.knowledge_id = k.id AND k.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN bedrock_ai_knowledge_doc d ON c.doc_id = d.id AND d.is_deleted = 0 WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.is_deleted = 0
